name: Old Murk-Eye
summary: Near the Westfall Lighthouse, Old Murk-Eye prowls the southern coast. His kind revere him, and sailors fear the lethal menace he poses to anyone who wanders near the lighthouse.

sections.title: Terror of the Coastline
sections.body: Old Murk-Eye prowls the surf around the Westfall Lighthouse, where he is far tougher and more aggressive than the murlocs common along Westfall’s shores. His attacks have brought enough grief to local mariners that the spectral Captain Grayson seeks his death. Grayson offers a bounty for Old Murk-Eye’s pristine scales, hoping to break his hold on the shallows.

aliases: where to find old murk eye
faq.answer: Old Murk-Eye patrols the sandy shores and shallow waters of southwestern Westfall, along the coast near the Westfall Lighthouse.

faq.q: Why does Captain Grayson want Old Murk-Eye dead?
faq.answer: Captain Grayson sees Old Murk-Eye as a persistent threat to the coastal waters. He offers a bounty for a scale as proof of the deed, hoping to curb the violence along the beach.

faq.q: Is Old Murk-Eye different from ordinary murlocs?
faq.answer: Yes. Old Murk-Eye is stronger, more durable, and more aggressive than the Coastrunner and Tidehunter lackeys around him. He acts as a tribal champion among the local shoreline packs.

angles.text: For Alliance adventurers clearing Westfall, Old Murk-Eye is a notorious predator who preys on stranded travelers and ship crews.
